title: Zesty Gooey Saudi Arabian Peaches Tagine
description: A funky and festive Saudi Arabian dish featuring katsuramuki-cut peaches in a rich and gooey sauce, perfect for a unique dessert experience. This egg-free friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, honey, lemon juice, ground cinnamon, and ground ginger.
Add the katsuramuki-cut peaches to the bowl and toss to coat with the sugar mixture.
Transfer the peach mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Dot the top of the peaches with the unsalted butter.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the peaches are tender and the sauce is gooey.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cinnamon if desired.
